method.data: reports/oof_predictions_train.csv.gz: out-of-fold Random Forest scores on the TRAIN split (StratifiedGroupKFold(5) by registered domain). The test split is not used.
method.high: Lowest score s such that precision (phishing among URLs scoring >= t) is >= 0.95 for t = s and for every higher score t (running minimum of precision from the top).
method.low: 5th percentile of training phishing OOF scores: about 5 % of training phishing falls in Low by design.
method.tiers: High: score >= high; Low: score < low; Medium: otherwise.
method.escalation: >= 2 strong rule hits -> High; 1 strong -> one tier up; >= 3 weak hits -> Low becomes Medium; info hits never change the tier; rules never lower the tier.
method.prevalence_caveat: Precision depends on the phishing share of the data (42.7% in train). Real-world traffic has far less phishing, so real precision at these cut-points is lower.
